terms.title: Before You Use Community Modules
terms.body:
Community modules are third-party contributions and are not affiliated with this project.

By installing and running community modules you agree to accept the associated risks:

• The project makes no guarantees regarding the safety, stability, or correctness of any community module.
• Community modules run locally on your server and process your recorded files — please verify that the source is trustworthy.
• It is recommended to review the module's source repository before installing.

If you understand and accept these risks, you may proceed.
